This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Scattered over Normandy on D-Day, Lieutenant Ronald Speirs forged a legend through ruthless action and decisive leadership. From Brecourt Manor to Bastogne and Foy, his wartime career is marked by heroism, controversy, and moments that still spark debate. This is the true story of one of World War II’s most feared paratroopers.
